title: Even if the Iran war ends, the next fossil fuel shock is already on its way

title: $50 million paid for huge T-Rex fossil at auction
description: A Tyrannosaurus rex fossil billed as one of the world’s largest and most complete specimens has sold for a record $50.1 million at an auction.

title: Fish kill at Fossil Creek Park likely caused by low oxygen
description: Hundreds of dead fish at Fossil Creek Park are likely due to high heat and low oxygen levels, according to wildlife officials.
